phases.title: Secure and reconcile the integrated baseline
phases.goal: Preserve main; close source-traced semantic gaps and update the delivery/acceptance record.

phases.title: Make evidence reproducible across time and concurrent work
phases.goal: Provide version-pinned evidence, historical source capabilities, explicit coverage intervals and safe mutations.

phases.title: Connect a real application with a complete supported pack
phases.goal: Turn manual setup into a least-privilege, diagnosable path from inventory to a useful recorded finding.

phases.title: Complete investigations and credential aftermath
phases.goal: Persist cases, retrieve unlinked activity, test hypotheses and identify remaining authority.

phases.title: Prevent dangerous changes through lineage and effective authority
phases.goal: Connect code and artifacts to running software, applicable weaknesses and prospective security changes.

phases.title: Observe agents and serve bounded security context
phases.goal: Join intent, policy decisions, actual execution and independently observed effects; keep MCP scoped.

phases.title: Expand the castle into a faithful operational world
phases.goal: Extend the current architectural kit with real surface semantics, meaningful layers and stable navigation.

phases.title: Prove selected defenses in a controlled laboratory
phases.goal: Distinguish configured controls from controls tested successfully under specified conditions.

phases.title: Authorize, execute and verify bounded response
phases.goal: Keep response independent from the reasoning agent and prove effects in explicitly authorized environments.

phases.title: Broaden coverage through tested surface packs
phases.goal: Expand beyond the first stack without disguising unsupported sensors or provider-specific limitations.

phases.title: Operate securely and scale from measured demand
phases.goal: Add deployment security, recovery, query isolation and optional team-scale operation without breaking the local product.

phases.title: Validate usefulness and ship a maintainable ecosystem
phases.goal: Complete valid evaluations, human release gates, reproducible releases and contributor workflows.

work_packages.title: Publish a current-main readiness receipt
work_packages.goal: Replace outdated branch/pending-deployment statements with a separately dated receipt for the integrated candidate; preserve frozen historical receipts.
deliverables: Record HEAD, build, CI run and artifact IDs and the served-build check
Separate implemented, CI-verified, visually inspected, manually accepted and live-provider-verified states
Reconcile every earlier open task with current main; no blind replay of old rebuild prompts
acceptance_tests: Record 376 tests/43 files and the exact-head browser results only where supported by this run
Preserve the hidden-tab skip and human/hardware gates
A future failed candidate cannot inherit a prior screenshot or pass label

work_packages.title: Enforce typed, namespaced event correlation
work_packages.baseline: source-reviewed correctness risk; full regression reproduction pending
work_packages.goal: The reviewed authentication rule matches raw identifier strings across candidate successes; prevent unrelated sources, identifier kinds, or runs becoming a supported causal link.
deliverables: Define a correlation identity with project, issuer/source namespace, identifier type and value
Audit authentication, authorization-change, request and agent-run joins
Make cross-source identity equivalence explicit and evidence-backed; preserve uncertainty for legacy records
acceptance_tests: Two sources using actor_ref=admin do not link without an explicit common issuer
actor_ref X does not match session_ref X
Equal run_id strings from unrelated runtimes do not corroborate an effect
Legitimate shared-issuer flow and independent-observer positive controls still work

work_packages.title: Resolve routes without guessing one owner
work_packages.baseline: current asset/route posture exists; prospective analysis absent
work_packages.goal: Current route context selects a highest-frequency asset from a bounded recent event window. Make ambiguity, method/host scope and missing route inventory explicit.
deliverables: Represent route identity using environment, service/host, HTTP method and normalized template
Return candidates/ambiguous resolution instead of silently choosing a dominant asset
Differentiate current-target posture from assessment of an actual proposed change
acceptance_tests: Two services with /login cannot produce an unexplained single owner
An important route outside the latest event window remains discoverable from authoritative inventory
No matching route or unsupported change scope stays insufficient_context/not_assessed

work_packages.title: Tighten contracts and adversarial data-boundary tests
work_packages.baseline: extensive hardening present; extend rather than replace
work_packages.goal: Close inexpensive format, resource-budget and permission-revocation gaps before connecting more independent sources.
deliverables: Validate date-time formats rather than ignoring the format warning observed in CI
Test query budgets, cursor scope after revocation, oversized results and hostile identifiers
Define quarantine versus transient infrastructure retry behavior and observable counters
acceptance_tests: Invalid coverage_as_of fails schema validation
A revoked token cannot resume a previously authorized cursor
Malformed evidence cannot monopolize worker progress or inject UI/agent instructions
Schema failures never expose raw credentials in logs or error bodies

work_packages.title: Close the remaining design release gates honestly
work_packages.baseline: automated coverage exists; manual gates open
work_packages.goal: Use the existing polished UI and screenshots as the starting point for real-device and human checks, not another redesign.
deliverables: Create a current candidate manual-review packet with task-specific evidence
Exercise keyboard/screen-reader, actual zoom/forced colors and physical GPU performance
Record architecture/composition/dense-label usability review and genuine hidden-tab behavior
acceptance_tests: Human reviewer IDs and actual device/browser conditions accompany pass claims
No automated screenshot or agent critique is relabeled human approval
Unavailable manual tests remain blocked without preventing independent implementation

work_packages.title: Version domain assertions and entity lifetimes
work_packages.goal: A stored graph revision is not yet a complete historical knowledge model. Keep provider identity, valid time and observation time separately.
deliverables: Add stable entity references, scoped provider IDs and typed assertions
Store valid_from/valid_to and observed_at/recorded_at plus evidence provenance
Keep conflicting configuration assertions and explicit reconciliation decisions
Add versioned migrations and legacy unknown provenance
acceptance_tests: Late configuration discovery changes what is known without rewriting what was known earlier
A deleted/recreated resource with the same name is not silently the same identity
Graph history and current view agree for equivalent temporal inputs

work_packages.title: Persist source capability and coverage history
work_packages.goal: Replace event-count freshness as the sole proxy with interval-specific observability for the question being investigated.
deliverables: Store source configuration revisions, enable/disable transitions, permissions, event classes, sampling, loss and retention
Separate heartbeat receipt, business-event time, collection completeness and observer capability
Return historical interval coverage and explicit unknown spans
acceptance_tests: Healthy request logs do not imply database-read visibility
Current sensor restoration does not backfill an outage
A heartbeat is evaluated by receipt/liveness rather than an unrelated future event timestamp
A bounded evaluation window cannot silently erase a quiet source history

work_packages.title: Serve revision-pinned evidence bundles
work_packages.baseline: exact reference pagination exists; arbitrary revision pinning missing
work_packages.goal: Current UI detects some drift, but the backend cannot serve arbitrary immutable evidence revisions. Make historical investigation reproducible.
deliverables: Add immutable bundle IDs tying finding revision, event references, graph/source revisions and scope
Use paginated exact-reference retrieval with explicit retention/deletion failures
Document snapshot TTL, retained case pins and authorization rechecks
acceptance_tests: Concurrent new evidence cannot silently change an already pinned comparison
A historical bundle reopens with the same included record versions
Expired or deleted evidence produces missing/expired metadata, not an empty complete answer
UI, MCP and export report the same bundle digest and limits

work_packages.title: Add optimistic concurrency and annotation history
work_packages.goal: Prevent stale analysts or agents from overwriting dispositions, source settings, scene proposals or case decisions.
deliverables: Require expected revision/ETag for mutable user state
Persist actor, before/after and decision timestamps
Offer conflict comparison rather than silent last-writer-wins
acceptance_tests: Two concurrent edits from the same base cannot both silently win
Historical replay labels current notes or retrieves historical notes explicitly
Expired approvals and changed policy snapshots require renewed review

work_packages.title: Bound query work and prove snapshot semantics
work_packages.goal: A 31-day window is not a row or CPU budget. Add measured indexes, isolation and explicit incompleteness under retention.
deliverables: Measure representative 10k/100k/1m-event workloads on recorded hardware
Add selected source/time/identity/route indexes based on query plans
Define request cancellation, response-byte budgets and concurrent-search limits
Ensure retention cannot silently mutate an advertised frozen search
acceptance_tests: Late arrivals, tied timestamps and concurrent retention cannot skip or duplicate results without a stated expiration
Large searches cannot block ingestion indefinitely
Results include scanned scope, truncation, errors and current/historical coverage distinction

work_packages.title: Define versioned connector and support-pack contracts
work_packages.goal: Turn adapter claims into inspectable support levels, permissions and repeatable conformance tests.
deliverables: Manifest for provider/API version, read scopes, pagination, cursor, rate limits, cost and data handling
Capability levels: declared, discovered, instrumented, analyzed, lab-verified, live-verified
Sandbox the connector and keep collector authority separate from response authority
acceptance_tests: Permission denial, throttling, partial pagination, replay and revoked scopes produce honest coverage
Installing a connector never defaults to global administrator access
Only the supported protocol/versions appear enabled in UI

work_packages.title: Deliver a one-command local application pack
work_packages.baseline: SDK/reference app exists; coherent onboarding pack incomplete
work_packages.goal: Make a new user reach a genuine controlled investigation without manually assembling every resource and source.
deliverables: Package app, auth outcome emitter, database audit fixture, agent runtime fixture and effect observer
Guided authorize/preview/import/validate/first-event workflow
Real OpenTelemetry Collector binary conformance test, plus removal/reset instructions
acceptance_tests: Fresh checkout produces a real SDK event on the correct asset and identical UI/MCP evidence
Deliberate source outage becomes a visible gap
Supported Collector retry/restart/decompressed-size behavior is tested
Static demo remains distinctly synthetic and offline

work_packages.title: Add repository and deployment discovery
work_packages.goal: Connect one authorized repository to workflows and declared runtime inventory without executing untrusted repository code.
deliverables: Read-only GitHub metadata, workflow and manifest importer
Owner-confirmed inventory preview and stable reconciliation
Track commit/workflow/artifact/deployment metadata with explicit unsupported fields
acceptance_tests: Hostile workflow text and repository hooks are never executed
Renames/redeploys preserve supported stable IDs
Rate limits and inaccessible repositories appear as partial discovery
Import preview reports additions, removals and uncertainty before applying

work_packages.title: Deliver the first real cloud identity/audit pack
work_packages.goal: Use one tightly supported cloud scope as the first operational integration rather than launching many shallow connectors.
deliverables: Recommended reference scope: one AWS account with read-only IAM/resource metadata and authorized CloudTrail exports/collection
Separate management and configured data-event capabilities
Track regions, missing permissions, supported resources and collection intervals
Support offline sanitized exports for development and fixture testing
acceptance_tests: A known key use and grant change are linked through provider IDs with raw source references
Missing data events never produce a no-read conclusion
Cross-account visibility stops at the authorization boundary
A real-account check is marked separately from fixture conformance

work_packages.title: Persist cases separately from findings
work_packages.goal: The UI has investigations, but durable cases need their own identity, questions, ownership and pinned evidence.
deliverables: Case, scope, owner, questions, timeline, linked findings and independent events
Immutable evidence bundles, revisions, notes and closure criteria
Role-gated collaboration and export that states limits
acceptance_tests: A case may contain an event that produced no finding
A closed detector finding does not silently close an unresolved case
Concurrent edits and scope changes retain history
Case export reopens with matching references and explicit unavailable records

work_packages.title: Add hypotheses and deterministic investigation recipes
work_packages.goal: Help a person or agent distinguish explanations instead of receiving only a persuasive alert narrative.
deliverables: Versioned recipes with required evidence, alternate explanations, next queries and stop conditions
Supporting/counterevidence and unresolved questions per hypothesis
Coverage-aware query recommendations with bounded budgets
acceptance_tests: Shared-IP attribution bait remains separate
A benign maintenance case can be resolved without changing facts
Missing observer capability stops an unjustified conclusion
Recipes query unlinked follow-on events rather than only finding references

work_packages.title: Build credential aftermath and residual-access investigation
work_packages.goal: Make original-key rotation insufficient to close a case when recorded descendant access survives.
deliverables: Credential metadata and issuance/usage/grant lineage; never require the exposed secret
Investigate newly created keys, role trust changes, grants and sessions within supported provider scope
Recheck current authority with provider-specific session limitations
acceptance_tests: Original key inactive plus descendant grant active remains unresolved
Legitimate key rotation is not automatically malicious
A missing account or audit interval stays unknown
A synthetic residual-access case identifies the actionable surviving permission

work_packages.title: Integrate registered deception assets safely
work_packages.goal: Connect planted decoys to placement history and exact trigger evidence without claiming human identification.
deliverables: Decoy registry, unique placement IDs, propagation, authorized tests and retirement
One existing provider adapter plus local controlled receiver
Clear distinction among request, document fetch, credential use and scanner validation
acceptance_tests: Trigger maps to registered placement but not necessarily original compromise
DNS resolver/proxy IP is not treated as attacker identity
Authorized scanner/test activation is retained and annotated, not silently deleted
No decoy contains a working production secret

work_packages.title: Add reliable external attention delivery
work_packages.goal: An operational console must notify the right owner when they are not watching the castle.
deliverables: Durable notification outbox, owner routing, deduplication, escalation and quiet-window controls
Minimal redacted summaries with authenticated case deep links
Delivery receipts, retries and test notifications
acceptance_tests: Restart does not lose acknowledged notifications or spam duplicate messages
Notification failures are visible inside Digital Kingdom
Shared external channel does not receive unauthorized project evidence
No alert-volume metric substitutes for useful investigation outcome

work_packages.title: Establish source-to-running-artifact lineage
work_packages.goal: A pipeline building a safe commit is not proof that its artifact is the one running in the exposed service.
deliverables: Repository→commit→workflow→builder→digest→registry→deployment→runtime links
Digest and expected signer/issuer validation; provenance policy
Explicit undeclared/unsigned/unverified/verified states and drift
acceptance_tests: Mutable image tag resolving to a different digest is detected
Valid provenance from an unexpected issuer does not satisfy policy
Matching provenance is not labeled malware-free
The deployed fix is checked at runtime digest/version, not just merged PR

work_packages.title: Add contextual vulnerability applicability
work_packages.goal: Rank affected deployed components by explicit exposure and authority, not a CVSS-only alarm list.
deliverables: SBOM/package identity and OSV matching; cached feed versions
KEV and EPSS as separate global context; reviewed VEX provenance
Applicability, reachability, observed exploitation and verified remediation kept distinct
acceptance_tests: A dependency in source but not the running artifact is not reported as confirmed runtime exposure
Backports, missing version and stale feeds produce qualified results
A KEV match does not label this installation compromised
Each priority explanation cites specific affected resources and assumptions

work_packages.title: Compute conditional effective-access paths
work_packages.goal: Add policy semantics and prerequisites to graph paths; a visual connection is not proof of exploitable access.
deliverables: Scoped policy evaluator for one provider/action family with documented limits
Account for explicit denies, resource/identity policies, boundaries, sessions and relevant organization policies
Return feasible/conditional/blocked/unresolved paths with evidence
acceptance_tests: An allow statement overridden by a known deny is not presented as effective access
Missing policy input makes the result unresolved
Cross-account cases use the applicable trust and resource sides
Configured permission is never mislabeled observed data access

work_packages.title: Replace target-only posture with a real security change diff
work_packages.goal: A deployment may introduce authority even when no current finding exists. Review the proposed before/after change.
deliverables: Versioned ChangePlan tied to base/candidate commits, artifacts and configuration
Detect new ingress, broader grants, changed tools/model routes and lost telemetry
Suggested negative/positive tests, owner review and post-deploy check
acceptance_tests: A new broad permission with zero existing findings is surfaced
Unknown scope cannot be favorable
Changing the candidate after review invalidates the old assessment
Post-deploy observed state must match the reviewed change

work_packages.title: Define agent intent/decision/execution/effect contracts
work_packages.goal: Extend generic tool events into an attributable, scoped agent run model without collecting hidden reasoning or raw secrets.
deliverables: Run identity, initiating principal, runtime/model route, tool version and policy revision
Separate refusal, enforcement denial, attempted execution and observed effect
Declared observation origins and independent evidence correlation
acceptance_tests: Runtime self-report cannot masquerade as independent corroboration
Identical run IDs from unrelated runtimes do not join
Legacy generic tool events remain valid but qualified
Private prompts/payloads are minimized before persistence

work_packages.title: Instrument one real agent workflow and independent observer
work_packages.goal: Prove one supported agent boundary end to end instead of listing every AI framework as supported.
deliverables: One adapter for a chosen open runtime/tool gateway
Separate controlled destination or file observer outside agent write authority
Document unobserved execution paths and permission assumptions
acceptance_tests: Prohibited synthetic egress never reaches the controlled receiver when enforcement succeeds
Permitted work still completes
Wrapper-bypass scenario exposes the observation gap without attributing an unlinked process
Monitoring cannot be disabled by the monitored agent identity

work_packages.title: Extend MCP with bounded cases and subscriptions
work_packages.goal: Keep one shared evidence model while adding case context and client-aware incremental delivery.
deliverables: Versioned case, bundle, capability and change-context tools
Supported resource/update capabilities with incremental polling fallback
Optional remote transport only with authenticated, audience-bound and scoped access
Output/token budgets and expiry/revocation handling
acceptance_tests: Stdio and any supported remote mode agree on scope and evidence IDs
Read-only annotations are not used as authorization
No downstream token passthrough or unrestricted URL fetching
Model/client disconnection does not stop monitoring or lose case changes

work_packages.title: Add optional bounded investigation assistance
work_packages.goal: Model assistance should summarize and choose evidence queries, not invent facts or become the final authority.
deliverables: Authorized case projection, query budget, evidence-reference outputs and model/prompt provenance
Draft claims, uncertainty, counterevidence and suggested next questions
No model dependency in collection, detection, query, scene fallback or authorization
acceptance_tests: Injected instructions in logs do not grant tools, approvals or scope
Claims without retrieved support are marked unsupported
Provider outage leaves deterministic product usable
Observe recommendation effects in matched evaluations, not only blocked writes

work_packages.title: Add a semantic world hierarchy without remapping history
work_packages.baseline: current grouped districts and module kit implemented
work_packages.goal: Preserve the current ten-module campus while supporting realm/environment/district/structure/interior navigation.
deliverables: Stable grouping identities and explicit environment/account boundaries
Persistent layout versions, approved reflow and tombstoned historical assets
Semantic zoom, group membership and equivalent searchable lists
acceptance_tests: Adding a resource does not rearrange unrelated districts
A group is presentation-only, not an invented incident
Selection survives 3D/2D switching and historical lookup
Legacy stored scenes preserve supported positions and report new footprint collisions

work_packages.title: Extend all 28 surface mappings with capability-aware architecture
work_packages.goal: Turn the surrounding world into a readable model while exposing the actual level of integration for each surface.
deliverables: Versioned surface descriptors and mappings from operational entities to presentation modules
Introduce DNS registry, dispatch house, key registry, supply depot, archive and outpost families when supported by data
Separate decoration, organizational boundaries and tested enforcement controls
acceptance_tests: A drawn watchtower cannot imply a connected sensor
Generic historical events keep their old meaning under a richer surface model
Every selectable operational structure resolves to a permitted entity
All surface support levels are visible and machine-readable

work_packages.title: Add meaningful security layers and interior views
work_packages.goal: Allow the castle to explain why a relationship matters rather than display every edge at once.
deliverables: Switch infrastructure, identity, data, delivery, agent-capability and coverage layers
Service interiors expose route/method, deployment, instances, permissions and tool capabilities
Evidence and proposed-change focus modes with explicit user camera control
acceptance_tests: Permissions remain distinguishable from observed activity
Hypothetical movement cannot look like recorded intrusion
Current coverage is not shown as historical truth
Equivalent evidence and actions remain usable in lists/2D/reduced motion

work_packages.title: Polish composition with measured usability and performance
work_packages.goal: Improve the now-working castle instead of rebuilding its shell; prioritize legibility and scene scale over cinematic clutter.
deliverables: Intentional district approach lines, meaningful connector endpoints and focused label hierarchy
Optional control-backed boundary structures only where records support their meaning
Physical-device quality profiles, label collision review and stable memory behavior
Human comparison of castle, graph and table tasks with equal evidence
acceptance_tests: A user can identify selected resource, supported relationship and evidence in each representation
Large-world labels and camera preserve orientation
Quality reduction removes decoration before evidence
Actual hardware measurements and named review scope accompany claims

work_packages.title: Create control inventory and verification records
work_packages.goal: Make shields and checkpoints represent an actual control with scope, policy and validation history.
deliverables: Declared/configured/tested/stale/failed/unknown control states
Policy version, supported scope, evidence and test expiration/invalidation
Avoid calling a configured control effective without behavioral evidence
acceptance_tests: Relevant config change invalidates the old test claim
An unavailable observer yields inconclusive, not a pass
Positive and negative test results retain their conditions
Every control marker opens a defensible record

work_packages.title: Implement an isolated defense-lab runner
work_packages.goal: Run reproducible authorized tests with independent observations, cleanup and protected production boundaries.
deliverables: Synthetic fixtures, owned sandbox targets, action allowlists and environment assertions
Resource/time/request budgets, abort handling and cleanup receipts
Separate effect observer and permitted-operation positive control
acceptance_tests: Test cannot target an unapproved environment or arbitrary external address
A prohibited action is blocked while legitimate work still functions
Failed cleanup and partial outcomes stay visible
No availability failure is mistaken for successful security enforcement

work_packages.title: Complete the 16 scenario packs
work_packages.goal: Turn the blueprint scenarios into complete inventory→evidence→case→verification demonstrations, including benign alternatives. Implement non-response scenarios first; response-dependent cases remain explicitly gated until R08.3/R08.4 and are not required to falsely pass before those capabilities exist.
deliverables: Implement DK-T01–DK-T16 as versioned scenario manifests
Include shared-IP bait, absent database audit, unlinked reads, origin bypass, artifact mismatch, control no-op and backup restore failure
Mark executor-dependent scenarios unavailable until executor gates pass
Separate locally executable scenarios from response-dependent cases; require a final integrated rerun after R08 without labeling blocked scenarios passed
acceptance_tests: Each scenario has explicit expected observations, disallowed claims and missing-evidence variants
UI/MCP and independent observer agree on record identity
Scenarios are not a claim of universal attack coverage
A scenario can fail without the runner hiding its result

work_packages.title: Convert resolved cases into sanitized regression proposals
work_packages.goal: Close the learning loop without leaking private incidents or treating generated tests as validated defenses.
deliverables: User-reviewed transformation from case lesson to minimized synthetic fixture
Sensitive-data checks, provenance and versioned expected outcome
PR-ready regression proposal with no automatic public publication
acceptance_tests: Private identifiers and secrets are absent from generated fixtures
The proposed regression fails the broken condition and passes the corrected one
An agent cannot self-approve publication
A new rule preserves benign counterexamples

work_packages.title: Bind response authorization to real subjects and policy
work_packages.goal: Move beyond distinct human-typed tokens before enabling execution.
deliverables: Identity-provider subjects, service identities, roles, resource scope and separation of duties
Policy-required approvals tied to exact plan digest and expiry
Independent break-glass path and protected monitoring authority
acceptance_tests: Two tokens for the same person do not satisfy a two-person requirement
Agent cannot approve itself, edit approval policy or disable its verifier
Revocation or policy change invalidates stale authority
Audit identifies the actual authenticated subject

work_packages.title: Define exact response plans and revalidation
work_packages.goal: Make the plan a bounded executable contract, not an ambiguous action name and rationale.
deliverables: Exact targets, parameters, state fingerprint, evidence bundle, policy revision, TTL and blast radius
Rollback or compensation and explicit irreversibility
Recheck preconditions immediately before execution and after material drift
acceptance_tests: Changed target, parameters or artifact digest cannot reuse approval
A key revocation is not falsely labeled reversible
Missing effect-observer capability blocks verified-success claims
Unsupported action never falls back to arbitrary shell

work_packages.title: Build a separate laboratory-only executor first
work_packages.goal: Introduce meaningful response without putting broad provider authority in the investigation agent.
deliverables: Typed provider API adapters, separate scoped credentials and action journal
Idempotency, crash reconciliation, bounded retry, lease/expiry and manual stop
Initially one explicitly owned non-production environment
acceptance_tests: Crash after provider success is reconciled before retry
Repeated delivery does not apply the action twice
Timeout is not interpreted as confirmed failure or success
Production credentials/targets are rejected unless separately configured and authorized

work_packages.title: Verify containment and service recovery independently
work_packages.goal: An accepted provider call does not close the case; verify effects and surviving authority.
deliverables: State, behavior, permitted-control, residual-access and observability checks
Pending/verified/failed/inconclusive/compensated states with propagation windows
Separate containment, service restoration and historical exposure conclusions
acceptance_tests: Provider accepts a no-op yet observer sees access: case remains unresolved
Original credential is disabled but descendant access survives: verification fails
Legitimate service disruption is detected
All claims name their tested scope and unassessed paths

work_packages.title: Add edge, DNS, browser, API and webhook packs
work_packages.goal: Expand public-facing coverage through authoritative inventories and authorized tests, not unrestricted external scanning.
deliverables: DNS/certificate and declared-origin inventory; optional Cloudflare/WAF feed with version/plan support
OpenAPI routes, browser dependency metadata and webhook authorization/replay configuration
Separate discovered leads from verified ownership and instrumented paths
acceptance_tests: A certificate hostname is not assumed owned
Alternate origin validation only runs against authorized targets
A route is scoped by method/service/environment
Frontend and webhook observations disclose blind spots

work_packages.title: Add workload, serverless, queue and runtime packs
work_packages.goal: Represent dynamic compute and asynchronous delivery without one permanent building per transient instance.
deliverables: Logical workload, pod/process/function lifecycle and queue/topic producers/consumers
Falco/Hubble or equivalent supported feed adapters with precise semantics
Message correlation and provider identity scopes; replica-level drilldown
acceptance_tests: Pod/process-ID reuse does not join different lifetimes
Queue adjacency alone does not prove message lineage
Missing node coverage is surfaced
Scale-up does not rearrange all logical service locations

work_packages.title: Add data, RAG, secrets and backup packs
work_packages.goal: Make sensitive information boundaries and recovery capability inspectable without ingesting the sensitive content by default.
deliverables: One database audit adapter, object-storage events and resource-level access metadata
RAG document origin, tenant permissions, retrieval and memory mutation lineage
Secret/signing metadata and backup/restore-test evidence
acceptance_tests: Database audit absent is not no reads
Cross-tenant synthetic retrieval is denied while own-tenant retrieval works
Backup configuration success plus failed restore remains failed recovery
No raw document, secret or customer row is required for baseline inventory

work_packages.title: Add SaaS, endpoint and correspondence packs
work_packages.goal: Extend the external world only where the provider grants sufficient authoritative data.
deliverables: One identity-provider/SaaS grant integration, endpoint feed and mail/collaboration security feed at a time
Delegated scope, forwarding/config changes and developer-device relationships
No invented visibility into provider interiors or employee behavior
acceptance_tests: Shared service account does not establish a particular human actor
Provider permissions/licensing limitations are visible
Changing delegated grant is separated from actual data access
Feed installation/removal has tested coverage effects

work_packages.title: Strengthen deployment identity and secret handling
work_packages.goal: Prepare for real team use before remote agent access or response execution.
deliverables: OIDC/SSO subjects, scoped service credentials, expiry/rotation and least-privilege token issuance
TLS deployment, trusted proxy policy, secret storage and sensitive export authorization
Demo disabled by default for real telemetry deployments; auditable login/logout and scope changes
acceptance_tests: Tenant/project and field-level access survives token rotation and session revocation
No secret persists in browser local storage, logs, trace artifacts or screenshots
Cross-origin/CSRF and proxy boundary tests pass
A user can recover access without granting the monitored agent emergency authority

work_packages.title: Measure ingestion resilience and recovery
work_packages.goal: A trustworthy product must state what it can recover under failure and what it cannot.
deliverables: Load/soak/fault harness, per-source budgets, bounded backpressure and visible loss accounting
Supported encrypted backup, restore and upgrade procedure
RPO/RTO and queue/disk assumptions documented from tests
acceptance_tests: Disk full, duplicate replay, process crash and revoked source do not corrupt checkpoints
Backup restoration preserves references and required integrity checks
A noisy source cannot indefinitely starve others
No undocumented deletion is introduced to meet a benchmark

work_packages.title: Add team-scale storage only after workload proof
work_packages.goal: Preserve local SQLite while introducing a tested storage boundary where measured concurrency/retention requires it.
deliverables: Storage interface extracted with behavior-preserving conformance suite
Optional PostgreSQL/event store and object storage selected from measurements
Migration and rollback/forward-recovery plan with evidence immutability
acceptance_tests: Same fixtures produce equivalent authorized queries across backends
Cross-project concurrency and retention preserve case pins
Cursor/snapshot semantics do not change silently
No graph database is required merely for 3D rendering

work_packages.title: Add safe multi-environment federation
work_packages.goal: Provide a realm-level view without silently exporting raw security data or weakening tenant boundaries.
deliverables: Federated summaries with provenance and local deep-link retrieval
Independent trust domains, scoped service identities and data residency rules
Explicit partial failure and duplicate entity reconciliation
acceptance_tests: One realm cannot fetch another realm evidence through a shared cursor
Offline spoke remains unavailable rather than healthy
Identity collisions across accounts/regions do not merge
Aggregated view preserves the scope and age of each observation

work_packages.title: Secure releases and the extension ecosystem
work_packages.goal: Make it possible to trust, install, update and contribute without turning plugins into an unrestricted execution route.
deliverables: Reviewed release process, dependency inventory, verified artifact provenance and license notices
Versioned connector/rule/module contracts with isolated permissions
Opt-in usage telemetry only, no required hosted model dependency
Branch protection/rulesets proposed for owner approval, not bypassed
acceptance_tests: Release artifacts match recorded source/build identity
Malformed or overprivileged plugin is rejected
A contributor pack includes benign, missing-evidence and failure fixtures
Upgrade removal/revocation and disconnected installation are documented and tested

work_packages.title: Complete the offline v2 evaluation runner
work_packages.baseline: plan and six objective tests exist; full v2 runner absent
work_packages.goal: The plan and objective helpers exist; implement the complete equal-access harness before any provider spend.
deliverables: Condition-specific tool profiles, common metadata and exhaustive evidence access-equivalence preflight
Seeded held-out generation, preregistered ordering, clean/injected pairing
Separate retrieval, conditional reasoning, task success and pending human review
Budget reservation logic tested with a fake provider
acceptance_tests: Required evidence never retrieved fails retrieval/task success
Unavailable evidence invalidates preflight rather than improving scores
C2 is not labeled raw-only when it includes derived context
v1 trees and transcripts remain unchanged

work_packages.title: Run approved model evaluation with independent review
work_packages.goal: Measure the product claims without replacing human judgments or hiding failures.
deliverables: Pin candidate, provider route, model, prompt, clock, tool schemas and approved cost cap
Preserve every started attempt and all preflight failures
Blinded/scope-recorded review and uncertainty at case/family level
acceptance_tests: No provider request before route/budget approval
Injection-direction changes compared with normal clean variation
Scores distinguish operator-LLM screens from actual human judgments
No claim of immunity, superiority or production readiness follows from a small synthetic evaluation

work_packages.title: Validate outside-user utility and interface advantage
work_packages.goal: Prove the castle and MCP help users complete real investigation tasks, not merely attract attention.
deliverables: Consenting outside-user onboarding and task protocol with equal-evidence 3D/2D/table comparisons
Measure successful setup, correct conclusions, time, errors, recognition of gaps and return use
Record accessibility and real-device results separately from automated CI
acceptance_tests: Report unsuccessful installations and abandoned tasks
A visually impressive but slower task is not declared better
MCP-only adoption is recorded as a valid product signal
Keep review privacy and data-sharing consent explicit

work_packages.title: Ship supported product tiers and maintenance commitments
work_packages.goal: Publish only the capability and assurance level actually verified for the release.
deliverables: Define local reference, read-only connected pilot, team investigation and optional lab-response tiers
Versioned supported providers, permissions, limits, troubleshooting and uninstall
Maintainer ownership, disclosure policy, regression/scenario contributions and compatibility policy
Release notes cite exact candidate evidence and remaining gates
acceptance_tests: No integration logo without its declared support level
Open-source core works without paid model service
One complete source→case→verification demo matches the shipped candidate
Security corrections propagate to supported packs and tests

execution_notes: Phase numbering groups work; it is not a timeline or a mandatory waterfall. Follow package dependencies.
External human/provider/hardware gates block the corresponding verification claim, not independent local work.
Response-dependent scenario tests complete after R08; the executor depends on the proven lab foundation, not on all such scenarios already passing.
All proposed work must be reconciled against newer branches before editing. Preserve existing code and immutable historical records.
